items.heading: Most Commerce Students Hear "Digital
items.text: Most commerce students hear "digital marketing" and picture Instagram reels and canva templates, a field that seems disconnected from balance sheets and cost accounting. That picture is outdated.

items.heading: Strip Away the Exam
items.text: Strip away the exam-answer format and look at the raw skill your commerce coursework actually built, then map it directly onto marketing work.

items.heading: A Real Advantage Is Not
items.text: A real advantage is not a free pass. Commerce coursework builds the numeric base, but it leaves a genuine gap on the tool and creative side of digital marketing.
